第九章 皇帝的态度(1)

当今七皇子襄王安州治水有功，深受百姓景仰，百姓对之感恩戴德，从安州回京一路，各县百姓闻风而至，夹道欢迎。

那传言拿命与天赌，让上万居民日夜撤离咸城而保住上万居民性命的襄王妃，更是人人争睹其风采，都说有如神人降世，菩萨现身，惹得万民激动，甚者，有无缘进城一睹王妃尊容的人竟拿香远拜，祈求襄王妃保一家平安，万世太平。

诸如此类的传闻，日日涌入宫中——

近日来，朝堂内外风起云涌，暗藏变局，都等着圣心表态，毕竟赵全一案殷鉴不远，牵一发动全身，如左丞之势也是一夕垮台，岂能不慎？

襄王亲母敏贵妃近日低调再低调，就怕不小心触怒了龙颜，坏了自家儿子的前程，襄王的亲舅右丞秦士廉，更是称病不朝，省得圣上一见他便朝他开火。

可就算如此，外头的百姓却是依然不管不顾地，在通往京城的官道上列队欢迎襄王一行人，简直比皇帝出巡还要热闹。

“真是岂有此理！”

宣政殿上，皇帝乐熙大手在龙椅上一拍，震得在场几位德高望重的官员大老纷纷凝眉肃目，不敢妄言。

兵部尚书林凯也是沉默了一会才道：“之前才处死了一个妖言惑主扰乱朝纲的国师赵全，如今又来个故弄玄虚被奉为菩萨降世的王妃，陛下，此事不可不慎重以对。”

吏部尚书董谦跟着也附议道：“是啊，陛下，若这样的传言再继续下去，那百姓都信襄王妃一人，奉襄王妃如若神明，那陛下之威望与福德又将置于何处？”

一人之声望凌驾于当今圣上已经是冒犯，再让百姓纷纷赋予神佛之名，以神佛之礼敬之拜之，那还得了？这天下不就要换人坐了吗？

这一点，他们这些老臣都想得明白，高高在上的皇帝怎么可能看不明白？

本来，这回襄王到安州治水救了上万百姓乃大功一件，皇帝却迟迟未论功行赏，不就是忌惮着襄王的威望日盛？

但忌惮归忌惮，若皇帝不对有功之人论功行赏，不只会让众臣心寒，也会让百姓非议，因此，就算再怎么不乐意，这赏还是得赏的，但若有过……也是得罚的，这一功一过抵了，也变无功无过了。

皇帝的亲弟永平王乐晟上前一步，躬身道：“陛下，经臣弟多日查证，当日要不是襄王妃以身相赌让这些百姓立马迁离，这回暴雨安州将死伤上万人甚至更多，襄王妃此举虽说有些惊世骇俗，其目的却是为上万百姓的生命安危着想，也果真因此拯救了咸城百姓免于洪灾，百姓感恩她那日之举也是常理之中。”

“你的意思是朕的气量狭小啰？”

“臣弟不是个意思，臣弟只是想让陛下退一步想，与其说百姓将她奉为神佛，还不如说百姓感念她的菩萨心肠，毕竟，不是每个人都愿意拿自己的命来换众人的平安，陛下，这样好心的王妃，是陛下的儿媳，其功德福泽也是来自于陛下啊。陛下不只要赏，还应该重赏，如此，天下百姓将更加感念陛下恩泽，知道王妃对他们的庇护都是出自陛下之意啊。”

“是啊，陛下。”辅国大将军魏堑也上前附和，“襄王和襄王妃受命于陛下亲至安州治水有功，尽其所能替陛下护安州百姓性命周全，得重重的赏，因为不管是襄王还是襄王妃，他们所做的一切都是为了达成陛下爱民如子的心意。”

说的，还真是有些道理……

他是君王，所有臣子包括皇子之功，不都是他的功劳？

乐熙方才的盛怒因乐晟及魏堑的一席话终是消散了些，那堵在胸口上数日的郁闷感也淡去了。

或许是对朱延舞这“天生凤命”之女特别忌惮之故，事情只要一牵扯上这个女人，他就会不由自主地将事件放大数十倍来看，不知不觉地便陷入自我的迷障之中……

“两位爱卿说得甚是，是朕糊涂了。”

“陛下不得不防啊！”林凯见皇帝竟被说服了，不由急道：“当年太子不就是攒了点民心就贪谋皇位……”

“林大人，慎言！”乐晟凝眉，冷眼扫了过去，“当年太子攒的不是民心，是圣意，是陛下的爱护之心，却不懂珍惜，才会酿成逼宫之举。”

魏堑也皱了皱眉，“林大人是否很不愿意见到襄王封赏？也很不高兴这次襄王在安州治水有成？守护百姓有功？竟将温文儒雅知书守礼，此次又治水有功的襄王与那逼宫谋反的前太子扯在一起？”

闻言，林凯气呼呼地道：“魏大将军说这什么话呢？我跟襄王无冤无仇，怎会见不得他好？只不过是替陛下多担了点心，提醒一下陛下罢了，倒是魏大将军是存有私心才一再替襄王说好话吧？”

“本将军有何私心？”

林凯哼笑了一声，“魏将军都把亲生爱女送到安州去了，不就是存着想和襄王结亲的心思？难道不是？魏大将军敢说，你没有把襄王择为女婿之意？”

魏堑黑了脸，不悦道：“林大人说什么浑话呢？我家知岚是领陛下旨意才去的安州，林大人现在是在指责陛下？”

什么？林凯一愕。魏家大小姐竟然是领圣上的旨意去的安州？

陛下此举是何意？难不成是陛下想要魏知岚当儿媳妇？不然巴巴的让人过去安州做什么？人家可还新婚呢，这么急着想塞人？这太怪了。

听见魏堑突然把他给扯出来，乐熙不由掩嘴轻咳了几声，“魏大小姐虽是女流，却打小生在军中，有姑娘家的细心体贴，也可以在必要时保护需要保护的人，更何况魏大小姐和襄王打小便认识，朕便安排让她去安州帮把手，林大人有意见？”

“臣不敢。”林凯头低得不能再低了。

可这一席君臣之言却让在场众臣个个凝眉，各怀心思，多少在心里有着一些计较，其中又以御史大夫齐志远犹胜，这位本来要将女儿齐若雨嫁给平王为妃而费尽心思，却让突然冒出的朱延舞给搅乱了整盘布局的男人，此刻当真是万般滋味在心头。

人家说，盖棺论定。人的是非功过，要到死后才能论定。

而在帝王之家，是非功过又岂可以轻易论定？不过是赢者为大罢了。

朝堂的棋局走到这里，该死守还是要进攻，也该有个决定了……

说是重赏，没想到真的是重赏。

皇帝因治水之功赐襄王及襄王妃黄金十万两，丝绸万匹，良田万亩，还有洛州食邑三千户，又特赐免死金牌一块给襄王妃，其中，尤以这免死金牌最让人诧异。

众说纷纭，都说是襄王妃以身为赌让百姓迁离，所以皇帝才特赐免死金牌一块给襄王妃，以嘉奖她的勇气可嘉，也有一说是皇帝担忧襄王妃这义气性子哪一天又来玩一出以身与天赌的戏码，为保其命，才特恩赐一块免死金牌给她。

无论如何，这回皇帝果真是大大的重赏了襄王夫妇，这是朝野上下及整个东旭王朝百姓都看得到的事实，而皇帝的重赏，让之前怕不小心捋了虎须而沉寂大半月的襄王府上上下下都欢欣鼓舞着，襄王一行人回到京城后，上门送帖拜庆贺的官员可以说是络绎不绝，门庭若市。

这样的结果，很是出乎朱延舞的预料，她手上拿着那块免死金牌，心里再三琢磨着，却怎地也猜不透皇帝的心思。

Chapter 9 The Emperor’s Attitude (1)

Today, the seventh prince, King Xiang, has made great achievements in controlling floods in Anzhou, and is deeply admired by the people. The people are grateful and grateful. On the way back to Beijing from Anzhou, people from various counties came to welcome him after hearing the news.

It was rumored that Princess Xiang, who risked her life against the sky and saved the lives of tens of thousands of residents by evacuating Xiancheng day and night, was even more popular. Everyone said that she was like a god coming to the world, or a Bodhisattva appeared, which aroused the excitement of all the people. What's more, some people who had no chance to come to the city to see the princess's face actually took incense and paid homage from afar, praying to Princess Xiang for her family's safety and eternal peace.

Rumors like this are pouring into the palace every day——

In recent days, there have been turmoils inside and outside the court, hidden changes, and everyone is waiting for the Sacred Heart to express its stance. After all, Zhao Quan's case is not far away, and it affects the whole body. Like Zuo Cheng, his power collapsed overnight. How can we be careless?

Prince Xiang's biological mother, Concubine Min, has been keeping a low profile recently for fear of accidentally offending Long Yan and ruining her son's future. Prince Xiang's uncle, Youcheng Qin Shilian, even claimed to be ill and refused to go to court, so as to prevent the emperor from opening fire on him when he saw him.

But even so, the people outside still didn't care, and lined up on the official road leading to the capital to welcome King Xiang and his party, which was even more lively than the emperor's patrol.

"This is really unreasonable!"

In the Xuanzheng Hall, Emperor Lexi slapped his big hand on the dragon throne, which shocked several highly respected officials and elders present to frown and not dare to speak nonsense.

Lin Kai, the Secretary of the Ministry of War, was silent for a while before saying: "Previously, Zhao Quan, the national advisor who deceived the emperor and disturbed the imperial court, was executed. Now, another concubine who is playing tricks on the emperor and was worshiped as a bodhisattva came to the world. Your Majesty, this matter must be dealt with carefully."

Dong Qian, the Minister of Civil Affairs, also agreed: "Yes, Your Majesty, if such rumors continue, then the people will believe in Princess Xiang and treat Princess Xiang as if she were a god. Then where will your Majesty's prestige and merit be placed?"

It is already an offense for one person's reputation to be higher than that of the current saints. What's more, if the people are to give the names of gods and Buddhas one after another and worship them with the same respect as gods and Buddhas?Isn’t it time for someone else to sit in this world?

They, the old ministers, all figured this out. How could the superior emperor not understand this?

Originally, this time King Xiang went to Anzhou to control the flood and saved tens of thousands of people, which was a great achievement. However, the emperor has not rewarded him for his merits. Isn't it because he was afraid of King Xiang's growing prestige?

But fear comes from fear. If the emperor does not reward those who have meritorious deeds, it will not only make the ministers feel cold, but also make the people criticize. Therefore, no matter how unhappy it is, the reward is still rewarded, but if there is a fault... you will also be punished. Once the merit is paid, it will become in vain.

The emperor's brother Yongping Wang Lexheng stepped forward and bowed: "Your Majesty, after many days of verification by my brother, if Princess Xiang had not bet her life to make these people move away immediately, this heavy rain in Anzhou would have killed or injured tens of thousands or even more people."Although Princess Xiang's move was a bit shocking, her purpose was to protect the lives of tens of thousands of people, and she really saved the people of Xiancheng from the flood. It is normal for the people to be grateful to her for her actions that day."

"You mean I have a small spirit?"

"My brother, I don't mean that. I just want your majesty to take a step back and think. Rather than saying that the people regard her as a god or a Buddha, it is better to say that the people appreciate her bodhisattva heart. After all, not everyone is willing to sacrifice their own lives in exchange for everyone's peace. Your majesty, soThe kind-hearted princess is your majesty’s daughter-in-law, and her merits and blessings also come from your majesty. Your majesty should not only reward you, but also reward her generously.In this way, the people of the world will be more grateful for your majesty’s kindness and know that your majesty’s protection is due to your majesty.”

"Yes, Your Majesty." Wei Que, the general of the auxiliary state, also stepped forward to agree, "King Xiang and Princess Xiang were ordered by Your Majesty to go to Anzhou to control the floods. They did their best to protect the lives of the people of Anzhou for Your Majesty, and received heavy rewards, because whether it was King Xiang or Princess Xiang, everything they did was to fulfill His Majesty's wish to love the people like his own children."

There is some truth in what he said...

He is the king, and all the achievements of his ministers, including the prince, are not due to him?

Lexi's anger finally dissipated due to Lexi and Wei Que's words, and the depression that had been stuck in her chest for several days also faded away.

Perhaps it was because he was particularly afraid of Zhu Yanwu, a daughter who was "born with a phoenix life". As soon as this woman was involved, he would involuntarily magnify the incident dozens of times, and unknowingly fall into his own confusion...

"What you two dear ladies are saying is true, but I am confused."

"Your Majesty has to be on guard!" Seeing that the emperor was actually persuaded, Lin Kai couldn't help but said anxiously: "Didn't the prince just gain some popular support and seek the throne..."

"Lord Lin, be careful what you say!" Le Sheng frowned and glanced at him coldly, "Back then, what the Crown Prince saved was not the support of the people, but the Holy Will, His Majesty's love and care. But he didn't know how to cherish it, and that's why he tried to force him into the palace."

Wei Que also frowned, "Mr. Lin, are you not willing to see King Xiang grant a reward? Are you also unhappy that King Xiang has succeeded in controlling the floods in Anzhou this time? Has he done a good job in protecting the people? How can he associate King Xiang, who is gentle, elegant, knowledgeable and respectful of books and etiquette, with the former prince who forced the palace to rebel?"

Hearing this, Lin Kai said angrily: "What did General Wei say? I have no grievances with Prince Xiang, so how can I not see him well? I just worry a little more for Your Majesty and remind Your Majesty, but General Wei has selfish motives for saying good things for Prince Xiang again and again, right?"

"What selfish motives does this general have?"

Lin Kai chuckled, "General Wei has sent his biological daughter to Anzhou, isn't it because he wants to marry Prince Xiang? Isn't it true? General Wei dares to say that you have no intention of choosing Prince Xiang as your son-in-law?"

Wei Yan's face darkened and he said displeasedly: "What nonsense did Lord Lin say? My family knows that Lan went to Anzhou just under His Majesty's orders. Now Lord Lin is blaming Your Majesty?"

What?Lin Kai was stunned.The eldest lady of the Wei family went to Anzhou on the orders of the Holy Emperor?

What does your Majesty mean by this move?Could it be that His Majesty wants Wei Zhilan to be his daughter-in-law?Otherwise, what would Baba want people to do in Anzhou?She is still newly married, so eager to get married?This is so weird.

Hearing Wei Que suddenly pull him out, Lexi couldn't help covering her mouth and coughing a few times, "Although Miss Wei is a female, she was raised in the army. With the care and consideration of a girl's family, she can also protect those who need protection when necessary. What's more, Miss Wei and Prince Xiang know each other since they were young, so I arranged for her to go to Anzhou to help. Mr. Lin, do you have any opinions?"

"I don't dare." Lin Kai lowered his head as low as possible.

However, the words of the emperor and his ministers made all the ministers present frown, each with their own thoughts, and some calculations in their hearts. Among them, Qi Zhiyuan, the imperial censor, was the winner. This man who originally planned to marry his daughter Qi Ruoyu to Prince Ping as his concubine, but had Zhu Yanwu suddenly appear and disrupt the whole plan, really felt all kinds of feelings in his heart at this moment.

People say that the final decision will be made when the coffin is sealed.A person's right and wrong cannot be determined until after death.

And in the house of the emperor, how can it be easily determined between right and wrong?It’s just about the winner.

The chess game in the court has come to this point, whether to defend or attack, it’s time to make a decision...

It was said to be a big reward, but I didn't expect it to be a big reward.

For their work in controlling floods, the emperor gave King Xiang and Princess Xiang one hundred thousand taels of gold, ten thousand pieces of silk, ten thousand acres of farmland, and three thousand households in Luozhou. He also gave Princess Xiang a gold medal for immunity from death. Among them, the gold medal for immunity from death was the most surprising.

There are different opinions. They all say that Princess Xiang gambled her life to make the people move away, so the emperor specially gave Princess Xiang a gold medal to avoid death to commend her courage. Some say that the emperor was worried that Princess Xiang's loyal temperament would one day play a game of gambling with heaven, so in order to save her life, he specially gave her a gold medal to avoid death.

In any case, this time the emperor really rewarded Prince Xiang and his wife greatly. This was a fact that could be seen by everyone in the government and the people of the entire Dongxu Dynasty. The emperor's generous reward made everyone in Prince Xiang's palace, who had been silent for more than half a month for fear of accidentally stroking the tiger's beard, rejoice. After Prince Xiang and his entourage returned to the capital, there was an endless stream of officials who came to deliver messages of congratulations.

Such a result was beyond Zhu Yanwu's expectation. She held the death-free gold medal in her hand and thought about it over and over again, but she couldn't figure out the emperor's thoughts.
